author: samxp95
quote:
The greatest psyop in gamin history, and right after Mixtape too. All of the critic reviews are just paid off, hardly anyone is actually "critical" in them. When your $1.5B in a day are on the line you better believe R* has made everyone's pockets extra heavy with healthy dose of threats to remove access in the future. In the world of everything artificial, I wouldn't have expected anything natural from this industry.

To the actual game review: 30fps is a literal scam in 2026. Story is very basic and mediocre imho. I don't know where the praise is coming from, seems like catered to all the ball and gun gamers who refuse to actually experience a good story. And the missions are more of a chore than actual missions. If I had to get groceries in my game I would just do it IRL.
